checks.Simpson_paradox: Separate domains: candidate-minus-user direction differs; do not pool away Toys regression.
checks.ecological_fallacy: Paired ranks and hit counts; average improvements do not imply universal user benefit.
checks.Berkson_selection: 512 repeatedly used development users; exploratory rather than independent confirmation.
checks.collider_bias: No rows excluded by outcomes; coverage groups are explicitly descriptive outcome-defined groups.
checks.base_rate_neglect: Absolute N10 and H10/H50 counts retained alongside relative gains.
checks.regression_to_mean: Seed0 fixed; prior branch selection and exploratory reuse remain limitations.
checks.survivorship_bias: All 1024 planned user records and all planned variants completed.
checks.look_elsewhere: All variants and both domains reported; unadjusted intervals, no definitive significance claims.
checks.forking_paths: Internal CE selects epochs; neither development N10 nor pure ranking selected seeds or variants for generation.
checks.causal_language: Multiple structural changes vs previous baseline; cannot attribute gain solely to removing residuals or expanding scope.
checks.reverse_causality: Feature API excludes target; stored targets only enter supervised ranker_fit loss and outcome evaluation.

decision: Single fusion is a viable provisional simplification; candidate-specific benefit is domain-dependent and expert necessity remains untested here.
